image.title: Import screenshot
image.introMobile: Take a screenshot with your device, then select it from your photos.
image.introDesktop: Select, drop or paste a screenshot, or capture the game window.
image.uploadNote: The selected area is uploaded only when you click “Recognize and solve”.
image.ocrNote: Screenshot recognition has only been verified for Simplified Chinese game screenshots. Changing the interface language does not change the recognition language.
image.dropNote: You can also drop here or paste into this page
image.captureUnsupported: Window capture is unavailable here. Choose, drop or paste an image instead.
image.captureSelecting: Choose the game window in the dialog…
image.errorType: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported.
image.errorSize: The image exceeds 12 MB. Reduce the file size first.
image.errorPixels: The image exceeds 20 megapixels. Reduce its dimensions first.
image.errorDecode: Could not read the image. Try a clear PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
image.errorCropSize: The cropped PNG exceeds 12 MB. Crop a smaller area or use the original.
image.errorCropPreview: Crop preview failed. Adjust the area or choose another image.
image.errorCaptureUnsupported: This browser or environment does not support window capture. Choose, drop or paste an image.
image.errorCapturePending: Capture cannot start yet. Close any existing selection dialog, return here and retry.
image.errorCaptureDenied: No window selected or capture cancelled. Your current image is unchanged.
image.errorCaptureUnavailable: Could not read the window. Check that it is not minimized or protected, then retry.
image.errorCaptureNoFrame: No frame captured. Select the game window and keep it visible, then retry.
image.errorCaptureEnded: Window sharing ended before capture. Your current image is unchanged.
image.errorCaptureTooManyPixels: The capture exceeds 20 megapixels. Reduce the resolution or choose an image.
image.errorCaptureTooLarge: The captured PNG exceeds 12 MB. Use a smaller window or choose an image.
image.errorCaptureEncodeFailed: Could not create a PNG screenshot. Retry or choose an image.
image.errorCaptureFailed: Capture failed. Retry or choose an image.
